options: a small circle in the line
a slight zigzag on the line
an opening or break in the line
explain: In standard electrical/circuit symbol conventions, a fuse is represented as a break or opening in the line (often with a small rectangle), symbolizing the circuit element that opens under fault conditions.

q: 34. Floor height shall not be less than ............. for hilly region.
explain: Building norms specify a minimum floor-to-floor (ceiling) height of 2.5 m for structures in hilly regions, accounting for local climatic and terrain considerations.

q: 35. Minimum width of corridors for primary school is .............
explain: School building design norms specify a minimum corridor width of 1.5 m for primary schools to allow safe and comfortable movement of students.

q: 36. The area of kitchen shall not be less than .............
explain: As per this reference's building norms, the minimum prescribed area for a kitchen is 2.5 m².

explain: A topographic map represents both natural details (terrain, rivers, vegetation) and artificial/man-made details (roads, buildings), making 'all of the above' the correct comprehensive answer.

q: 39. Minimum area of ............. square meter should be provided per bed in hospital.
explain: Hospital building design norms in this reference specify a minimum area of 45 m² per bed, accounting for the bed itself plus circulation, medical equipment, and support space.

q: 40. Floor height shall not be less than ............. for Terai region.
explain: Note: per the answer key, 2 m is marked correct for the Terai (plains) region in this reference; this contrasts with the higher 2.5 m minimum specified for hilly regions (Q257) due to differing climatic considerations.
